cards.mood: The piece opens with a tense, atmospheric buildup that quickly erupts into aggressive, high-energy instrumentation.
cards.palette: Heavily distorted electric guitars serve as the core harmonic and melodic drivers, utilizing palm-muted chugging rhythms in the verses and open, soaring power chords in the choruses.
